newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: MTMD to acquire Lonrho's Mauritian sugar assets.
newsitem.headline: MTMD to acquire Lonrho's Mauritian sugar assets.

text.p: Mauritian sugar concern Mon Tresor Mon Desert said on Monday it would acquire majority stakes in three sugar cane growing companies and a sugar milling factory from its holding company Swaziland-based Lonrho Sugar Corp.

"The acquisition will result in the incorporation of all Lonrho Sugar Mauritius assets in MTMD thereby simplifying the management and ownership structure," MTMD officials said in a statement on Monday.

"The acquisition enables MTMD's activities to be expanded from the ownership and operation of a single sugar estate to four sugar estates, thereby providing MTMD shareholders the opportunity to indirectly invest in the Lonrho Sugar Mauritius assets."
The acquisition will cost 1.235 billion rupees ($61.5 million) and MTMD proposes to finance the deal by issuing 36,323,529 new MTMD shares to Lonrho Sugar at 34 rupees each.
"Following the issue of these new shares to Lonrho Sugar, its shareholding in MTMD shall increase from 56.87 percent to 80.25 percent," the statement said.
After a request by the Mauritius Stock Exchange Lonrho Sugar Corp had committed itself to reducing its holding in MTMD to a maximum of 75 percent within a time limit of three years.

MTMD is also convening an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders on February 10 to propose doubling its authorised share capital to 600 million rupees by creating 40 million new shares of nominal value 7.50 rupees each.
During the meeting MTMD will also propose resolutions to acquire the Lonrho Sugar assets and to issue to Lonrho Sugar 36,323,529 shares at 34 rupees each to finance the deal.
Completion of the acquisition would also be contingent on authorisation by the Mauritius Prime Minister's office of the sale of Lonrho Sugar assets to MTMD, the MTMD statement added.
MTMD officials estimate annual average sugar production of the company will increase to 84,000 tonnes from a present 31,000 tonnes, making MTMD one of Mauritius' leading sugar producing concerns.
In addition to sugar, MTMD also holds stakes in the hotel and investment sector companies.
On Monday MTMD shares on the Mauritian bourse gained one rupee to 41.20 rupees.
